services.purpose: Serves private readiness and read-only upstream stats; admin stays on container loopback. No app ingress is configured.

acceptance.description: GET /health on the exact saved loopback origin returns 200; this proves only the private Caddy configuration is serving, not application ingress or Homarr widget acceptance.
After separate approval for one route and DNS/TLS/80/443/auth ownership, verify the intended backend through that exact route; this recipe does not configure one.
Restart the exact owned Compose project and verify the reviewed route and certificate state persist after ingress is separately configured.
